title: Associativity comparison components on K-flat representatives
statement: Let every scheme X [def-pc-scheme] have a chosen derived category D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. For every morphism f:X→Y let T_f be the additive tensor pullback pinned by the adjunction of [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and let L_f be derivedPullback f [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Write Q_X for the localization from the homotopy category of O_X-module cochain complexes, and T_f^h for the functor induced by T_f on homotopy categories. Choose natural transformations ε_f:Q_Y⋙L_f→T_f^h⋙Q_X making L_f a left derived functor; assume their components on every K-flat complex [def-pc-kflat-complex] are invertible. For each composable f:X→Y and g:Y→Z choose c(f,g):L_g⋙L_f≅L_(f≫g) such that its hom is the left-derived lift of the two successive counits followed by Q_X applied to the homotopy-category composition comparison. This underived comparison is the adjunction conjugate of pushforwardComp(f,g)^(-1), using exactly the pinned adjunctions Classical.choose of exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction. All functor reassociations in this lift are the canonical associators. For h:W→X, f:X→Y, g:Y→Z and every K-flat complex P of O_Z-modules, at Q_Z(P) the components of the following two natural transformations agree: the hom of whiskerRight c(f,g) L_h followed by c(h,f≫g); and the hom of the associator of L_g,L_f,L_h followed by whiskerLeft L_g c(h,f), then c(h≫f,g), then transport along Category.assoc h f g. This is only equality on K-flat representatives and contains no identity comparison or unit law.

proof.text: The termwise tensor pullbacks of P along g and then f are K-flat. Thus the successive counits at these representatives and at P are invertible.

Evaluate the lift factorizations for (f,g), (h,f), (h,f≫g), and (h≫f,g) at P or the appropriate tensor pullback representative. Postcompose each triple path with the counit of the total composite at P. Naturality moves the counits through comparisons and both expressions become the same ordered three counits followed by the two underived tensor triple comparisons. Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso_assoc applied to the pinned adjunctions and pushforward_assoc identifies these comparisons, including transport along Category.assoc. Cancel the invertible total-composite counit at P to obtain the equality. No global natural-transformation descent is asserted.
